explanation: We count the number of holdings in the current schedule versus the prior schedule for each BDC by joining holdings and filings. We calculate the difference as current minus prior, order by the added holdings in descending order, and limit to the top 5 BDCs.
raw: {"sql": "SELECT f.name AS bdc, COUNT(CASE WHEN h.period_role = 'current' THEN 1 END) - COUNT(CASE WHEN h.period_role = 'prior' THEN 1 END) AS holdings_added, COUNT(CASE WHEN h.period_role = 'current' THEN 1 END) AS current_holdings, COUNT(CASE WHEN h.period_role = 'prior' THEN 1 END) AS prior_holdings FROM holdings h JOIN filings f ON h.adsh = f.adsh GROUP BY f.name ORDER BY holdings_added DESC LIMIT 5", "explanation": "We count the number of holdings in the current schedule versus the prior schedule for each BDC by joining holdings and filings. sql: SELECT f.name AS bdc, COUNT(CASE WHEN h.period_role = 'current' THEN 1 END) - COUNT(CASE WHEN h.period_role = 'prior' THEN 1 END) AS holdings_added, COUNT(CASE WHEN h.period_role = 'current' THEN 1 END) AS current_holdings, COUNT(CASE WHEN h.period_role = 'prior' THEN 1 END) AS prior_holdings FROM holdings h JOIN filings f ON h.adsh = f.adsh GROUP BY f.name ORDER BY holdings_added DESC LIMIT 5
